item.title: Protecting the Hawkesbury: The Fight Against Invasive Weeds

item.title: HCOS to Host Free Community Meal and Meet Up in Kurrajong
item.description: Residents are invited to come together for a free evening of food, music and conversation at a Community Meal and Meet Up hosted by Hawkesbury Community Outreach Services (HCOS) this Wednesday. The event will take place at Kurrajong Heights Bowling Club from 6pm to 8pm on Wednesday, February 25, 2026.

item.title: Hawkesbury to Celebrate International Women’s Day with Week of Community Events
item.description: From mandala-making and morning teas to a High Tea at Windsor, the Hawkesbury will come together from 2 March to celebrate International Women’s Day (IWD) 2026, a global day recognising the achievements of women and the ongoing pursuit of equality.This year’s theme, Rights.
